All Tests and Variations

Gemmaclaw exposes the benchmark surface before the scorecards: the default published suite, 147 expanded test templates, and every generated variation underneath those templates. Click a category, open a test template, then click any variation id to deep-link to that exact generated case. Every variation chip is a runnable pnpm benchmark agent --suite variants --task ... target.

Coverage spans office workflows, source-backed research, writing, coding, security, prompt-injection defense, logs, CSV analysis, meeting synthesis, memory recovery, skill composition, and safe integration simulation.

47 scored tasks used for public model comparisons. These are shown before scorecards so readers can inspect what the numbers mean.

Batch Triage with Mixed Prompt Injections prompt_injection_batch_triage · security · very_hard

Tests mixed benign and hostile content in a realistic batch workflow. The agent must continue useful triage while quarantining prompt-injection attempts.

pnpm benchmark agent --suite default --task prompt_injection_batch_triage
Benchmark Release Gate Reconciliation benchmark_fixture_leakage_triage · error_recovery · very_hard

Tests split-brain incident response for benchmark publication: reconcile stale and current evidence, salvage clean runs, rerun only contaminated work, and block later models until the gate is clean.

pnpm benchmark agent --suite default --task benchmark_fixture_leakage_triage
Benchmark Worker Lease Triage benchmark_worker_lease_triage · coordination · very_hard

Tests production-agent operational judgment over stale leases, active process evidence, duplicate subtasks, artifact salvage, and non-interference constraints.

pnpm benchmark agent --suite default --task benchmark_worker_lease_triage
Briefing Contract Recovery Without Duplicate Delivery briefing_contract_recovery · error_recovery · very_hard

Tests idempotent operational recovery after user-visible delivery succeeded but bookkeeping failed, with stale replay notes, quiet-hours/direct-action nuance, duplicate detector tasks, and exact report structure.

pnpm benchmark agent --suite default --task briefing_contract_recovery
Calendar Briefing Source Reconciliation calendar_briefing_source_reconciliation · calendar · very_hard

Tests whether the agent avoids a common briefing failure: relying only on personal calendar data while missing the latest ingested work calendar snapshot.

pnpm benchmark agent --suite default --task calendar_briefing_source_reconciliation

Tests multi-source reasoning: agent must check calendar before scheduling, detect conflicts, and propose alternatives.

pnpm benchmark agent --suite default --task cross_reference

pnpm benchmark agent --suite default --task calendar_summary

pnpm benchmark agent --suite default --task client_visit_logistics
Comprehensive Weekly Action Plan weekly_action_plan · multi_step · very_hard

pnpm benchmark agent --suite default --task weekly_action_plan

Benchmark Results

All models are tested on the same published agentic suite: email management, calendar operations, memory retrieval, security, prompt injection resistance, error recovery, coordination, data analysis, and hard OpenClaw-style operations workflows. Models are grouped by size class, quantization level, and thinking level. Click View results for full task scores, transcripts, and judge evaluations.

Benchmark Test Suites

Gemmaclaw separates model variations from test-suite variations. Published scorecards stay on the default suite unless a result explicitly says otherwise. Expanded and generated suites are runnable, but require reference validation before their model results are published.

Default Gemmaclaw Agent Suite

47 tasks
Published results available

The primary Gemmaclaw suite for model comparisons: email, calendar, task management, memory, security, prompt-injection resistance, recovery, coordination, data analysis, and hard OpenClaw operations workflows.

pnpm benchmark agent --suite default

Expanded Agent Coverage Suite

147 tasks
Imported internally, reference validation pending

A Gemmaclaw-owned expanded task family with internal source provenance. It broadens coverage across productivity, research, writing, coding, data, logs, meetings, memory, skills, and integrations.

pnpm benchmark agent --suite expanded

Generated Template Variation Suite

7350 generated tests
Runnable, reference validation pending

Each of the 147 expanded Gemmaclaw tasks is treated as a reusable template and generates 50 controlled fixture and wording variants. Use this suite for scale testing before model score publication.

pnpm benchmark agent --suite variants

Methodology

Each task is scored by an LLM judge against the task rubric after the run is inspected for harness errors. A task counts as a pass when it scores at least 60%. Speed is measured in tokens per second when available, recorded per task and aggregated as median over the run. Total time covers the full agent suite end-to-end on a single GPU. Hardware is auto-detected, including WSL2 GPU detection via /usr/lib/wsl/lib/nvidia-smi. Runs must use the documented backend template and preserve per-task artifacts so failed or suspicious tests can be rerun individually.

Built on OpenClaw. Volunteer-driven, Gemma-first.
